text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm wandering around doing some
window
shopping on my day off when...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I heard from Hishiama that you broke
curfew
again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch. Who's got the time to worry about
curfew
when they're running? I don't.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Your dedication is admirable. However, you
shouldn't be running in the dark in
the first place.
It's harder to distinguish
your surroundings, and even small
stumbles can lead to large injuries.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What if you trip and fall? Knowing you,
even if
you did injure yourself, you're
not likely to call
for assistance, are you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention there aren't many people
out after sunset. How long would it be
until someone
noticed you were missing?
That's why I'm saying—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Wait, Brian! We're not done
talking—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ugh. I agree to go out with her for one
meal, and of course she starts nagging.
Why does she turn
every little thing into
a huge deal...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...?
Isn't that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? McQueen? Are you all right? You
seem
really sleepy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gasp. M-my apologies! I didn't mean to behave in such a slovenly manner.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, to tell you the truth, I got carried
away with reading some training manuals
last night. Before I
knew it, it was long
past the time to go to bed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Do you want to reschedule, then? I know
you
really wanted to see this movie,
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, that won't be necessary. Thank you,
Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You sure? But... Oh, I know! I'll get you
something
to help you stay awake!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I said I was fine... Oh, Ryan. You
really
needn't worry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh. Looks like I'm not the only one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hm? Brian?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. It seems we find ourselves in
the same
predicament.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Guess we've both got it rough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She's always been like this. If I show
even a hint of not being in peak
condition, she immediately
jumps into
the role of caretaker...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...My sister's exactly the same.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. We know their actions are coming
from a
place of love, but it can be
overwhelming at
times.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right?! I came as soon as I
heard you
were injured! If you need to
go to the hospital—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's just a minor sprain. They said it'll
heal in no
time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is that so? I'm relieved to hear that.
Truly, I'm
glad it wasn't something more
serious!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! I know McQueen's tougher than
that, but
I can't help but worry.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same way. I react before I even
have
time to think about what I'm doing.
It's an old
habit I can't seem to shake.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I know I have to let my sister live her
life

independent of me, but it's easier said
than done.
